snippet.title: Silly Polly Beast ► Launch Window Announcement Trailer At Top Hat Studios Tokyo Game Show Showcase
snippet.description:
An otherworldly, story-driven shooter with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. This is the story of a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast - and in order to become free, she was forced to study its nature. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom? Launching this October on PC, PS5, and Xbox.

Steam Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1598780/Silly_Polly_Beast/
